Method of Attack: Imitates the popular Browserify npm component to mislead developers
Spawns a persistent ELF executable on installation
Requests elevated or root permissions from the user
Uses legitimate npm components like 'sudo-prompt' to gain root privileges
Exfiltrates system information to an attacker-controlled domain
Attempts to remove contents of the /etc/ directory and disable critical Unix services
Attack Vector: Post-installation script extracts and launches a malicious ELF binary
Binary gains persistence by copying itself to /etc/rot1 and running on every boot
Indicators of Compromise: Archive: run.tar.xz containing the ELF binary
Uses 'systeminformation' npm component to collect system data
